events.headline: Dow and S&P 500 post worst day of 2013

reasoning: The only headline recaps the market's own -1.83% drop, so it names no cause and adds no new information. Regime is calm to normal (vol regime 2, 20-day vol 0.74%), with no 2%+ days in the last 10, so there is no cluster signal. The market is 5.6% above its 200-day average and 2.8% below its 252-day high, so the drop is a modest pullback. After a drop of about 2% the next day is up roughly 55%, but the handbook says this is not a reliable direction signal. My confidence in an up day is about 0.52, below the 0.55 threshold, so I stay flat.
would_change_my_mind: A named, new cause (policy, credit or geopolitical shock) or a second large down day with rising volatility would justify reassessing; a clear dovish surprise would justify a long.
